# `android` operations

25 operations. Generated from `assets/operations.json`; [all areas](README.md).

### android.input

**Tap / swipe / input**

Control real Android UI through adb, using device pixel coordinates. ASCII text is typed; other text is pasted through the device clipboard with the configured scrcpy 4.1 server on Android 7 and newer.

Annotations: writes, not idempotent, open world.

| Argument | Type | Required | Default | Details |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `device` | string | yes |  | non-empty; Device serial / UDID from device.list |
| `action` | string | yes |  | one of `tap`, `swipe`, `text`, `keyevent` |
| `x` | integer |  | `0` | 0 to 16384 |
| `y` | integer |  | `0` | 0 to 16384 |
| `end_x` | integer |  | `0` | 0 to 16384 |
| `end_y` | integer |  | `0` | 0 to 16384 |
| `duration` | integer |  | `300` | 1 to 10000 |
| `text` | string |  | `""` |  |
| `key` | string |  | `"KEYCODE_HOME"` |  |

```sh
tomaccoctl call android.input '{"device":"<device>","action":"tap"}'
```

### android.settings

**Device settings for tests**

Read or set what changes an app's look and motion in UI tests and screenshots: dark mode, font scale, animations, airplane mode and one app's language. Arguments left out stay as they are; the result reads every setting back and reports a value Android did not apply as setting_not_applied.

Annotations: writes, idempotent, open world.

| Argument | Type | Required | Default | Details |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `device` | string | yes |  | non-empty; Device serial / UDID from device.list |
| `dark_mode` | string |  |  | one of `on`, `off`, `auto`; System dark theme; auto follows the device schedule |
| `font_scale` | number |  |  | 0.5 to 2; System font size; 1 is the default |
| `animations` | boolean |  |  | false sets the window, transition and animator scales to 0; true sets them to 1 |
| `airplane_mode` | boolean |  |  | Android 11 and newer |
| `bundle_id` | string |  |  | App whose language app_locale sets and the result reads |
| `app_locale` | string |  |  | Language tags separated by commas, such as de-DE or fr,en; empty follows the device language again. Android 13 and newer. |

```sh
tomaccoctl call android.settings '{"device":"<device>"}'
```

### android.display

**Display orientation and size**

Lock the screen orientation, override the display size or density, or reset them, on a phone or emulator; the result reads all three back. A value Android did not apply answers setting_not_applied. With no other argument it only reads.

Annotations: writes, idempotent, open world.

| Argument | Type | Required | Default | Details |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `device` | string | yes |  | non-empty; Device serial / UDID from device.list |
| `orientation` | string |  |  | one of `auto`, `portrait`, `landscape`, `reverse-portrait`, `reverse-landscape`; Lock the rotation; auto follows the sensor again |
| `width` | integer |  |  | 100 to 10000; Override width in pixels, with height |
| `height` | integer |  |  | 100 to 10000; Override height in pixels, with width |
| `density` | integer |  |  | 72 to 1000; Override density in dpi |
| `reset` | boolean |  | `false` | Return size and density to the device's own and rotation to the sensor, before anything else given |

```sh
tomaccoctl call android.display '{"device":"<device>"}'
```

### android.notifications

**Notifications**

List the notifications Android is showing, with key, package, title, text, channel and flags; open or close the notification shade; or snooze one notification by its key. Every action returns the list afterwards. adb cannot cancel another app's notifications, so snooze hides one for a time instead.

Annotations: writes, not idempotent, open world.

| Argument | Type | Required | Default | Details |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `device` | string | yes |  | non-empty; Device serial / UDID from device.list |
| `action` | string |  | `"list"` | one of `list`, `open`, `close`, `snooze`; open and close expand or collapse the notification shade |
| `bundle_id` | string |  |  | List only this app's notifications |
| `key` | string |  |  | Notification key from the list, for snooze |
| `seconds` | integer |  | `3600` | 1 to 604800; How long snooze hides the notification |

```sh
tomaccoctl call android.notifications '{"device":"<device>"}'
```

### android.app_files

**App data files**

List or pull the private files of a debuggable app (its data directory, through run-as). pull returns a job that writes the files as one .tar archive. Release builds answer app_not_debuggable. To clear app data or force-stop the app, use device.app.

Annotations: writes, not idempotent, open world.

| Argument | Type | Required | Default | Details |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `device` | string | yes |  | non-empty; Device serial / UDID from device.list |
| `bundle_id` | string | yes |  | Application ID of a debuggable build |
| `action` | string |  | `"list"` | one of `list`, `pull` |
| `path` | string |  | `"."` | File or directory inside the app's data directory, relative to it, such as files or databases/app.db |
| `output` | string |  | `""` | Absolute local path of the .tar archive, for pull |

```sh
tomaccoctl call android.app_files '{"device":"<device>","bundle_id":"<bundle_id>"}'
```

### android.each

**Run on every Android device**

Run the same steps on every connected Android device, or on the listed ones, as one job: all devices at once, each device's steps in order until one fails. A step that returns a job is followed to its end. The job's report.json artifact has every device's result; the job fails if any device failed. Steps leave out device and platform, which are set per device.

Annotations: **destructive**, not idempotent, open world.

| Argument | Type | Required | Default | Details |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `steps` | array of object | yes |  | 1 to 20 items |
| `steps[].operation` | string | yes |  | one of `device.install`, `device.app`, `android.launch`, `android.permission`, `android.settings`, `android.display`, `android.deep_link`, `android.input`, `android.notifications` |
| `steps[].arguments` | object |  | `{}` | The operation's arguments without device and platform |
| `devices` | array of string |  |  | up to 100 items; Serials from device.list; all online Android devices when left out |
| `timeout` | integer |  | `1800` | 10 to 86400; Seconds for the whole job |

```sh
tomaccoctl call android.each '{"steps":[{"operation":"device.install"}]}'
```

### android.avd_configure

**Set emulator performance**

Persist graphics, RAM and CPU settings for a stopped registered Android emulator. Preserves app data and other configuration, saves the original configuration, and skips incompatible VM snapshots on subsequent Tomacco starts. Running AVDs are rejected.

Annotations: writes, idempotent, open world.

| Argument | Type | Required | Default | Details |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `name` | string | yes |  |  |
| `gpu` | string |  |  | one of `auto`, `host`, `software`, `swiftshader`, `lavapipe` |
| `memory_mb` | integer |  |  | 512 to 32768 |
| `cores` | integer |  |  | 1 to 32 |
| `vulkan` | string |  |  | one of `auto`, `on`, `off`; Vulkan compatibility override; off keeps OpenGL ES and avoids the Vulkan interoperability path. Requires a cold restart. |

```sh
tomaccoctl call android.avd_configure '{"name":"<name>"}'
```

### android.avd_start

**Start emulator**

Start or reuse an Android virtual device. CPU acceleration remains enabled independently of the selected GPU renderer.

Annotations: writes, idempotent, open world.

| Argument | Type | Required | Default | Details |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `name` | string | yes |  |  |
| `headless` | boolean |  | `false` |  |
| `software` | boolean |  | `false` |  |
| `gpu` | string |  | `"configured"` | one of `configured`, `auto`, `host`, `software`, `swiftshader`, `lavapipe`; configured respects the saved AVD renderer; auto selects a compatible renderer; host uses the computer GPU. An override applies to this start. Changing renderer requires stopping the emulator first. |
| `cold_boot` | boolean |  | `false` | Skip saved VM snapshots, for example after changing the GPU renderer. App data is retained. |
| `audio` | boolean |  | `true` | Enable the emulator host audio backend independently of headless mode. Embedded clients can disable this and use runtime.audio instead. Applied only to a new emulator process. |
| `vulkan` | string |  | `"configured"` | one of `configured`, `auto`, `on`, `off`; Vulkan compatibility override; off keeps OpenGL ES and avoids the Vulkan interoperability path. Requires a cold restart. |

```sh
tomaccoctl call android.avd_start '{"name":"<name>"}'
```

### android.emulator

**Control emulator**

Stop an emulator; save, load, list or delete its snapshots; set its GPS location, battery or network speed and latency through the emulator console. A command the console refuses answers emulator_refused.

Annotations: **destructive**, not idempotent, open world.

| Argument | Type | Required | Default | Details |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `device` | string | yes |  | non-empty; Device serial / UDID from device.list |
| `action` | string | yes |  | one of `stop`, `snapshot-save`, `snapshot-load`, `snapshot-list`, `snapshot-delete`, `location`, `battery`, `network` |
| `name` | string |  | `"default"` | Snapshot name for snapshot-save, snapshot-load and snapshot-delete |
| `longitude` | number |  | `0` | -180 to 180 |
| `latitude` | number |  | `0` | -90 to 90 |
| `battery_level` | integer |  | `100` | 0 to 100; Battery charge in percent, for battery |
| `charging` | boolean |  | `true` | Whether the charger is connected, for battery |
| `network_speed` | string |  | `"full"` | one of `gsm`, `hscsd`, `gprs`, `edge`, `umts`, `hsdpa`, `lte`, `evdo`, `5g`, `full`; Network speed preset, for network; full means no limit |
| `network_delay` | string |  | `"none"` | one of `gprs`, `edge`, `umts`, `none`; Network latency, for network: gprs 150-550 ms, edge 80-400 ms, umts 35-200 ms, none adds no latency |

```sh
tomaccoctl call android.emulator '{"device":"<device>","action":"stop"}'
```

### android.package_inspect

**Inspect APK or AAB**

Read an APK or AAB without a device: package, version name and code, minimum, target and compile SDK, permissions, native ABIs and signing certificates with their SHA-256 digests. APKs go through aapt2 and apksigner from the SDK build-tools; an AAB's manifest is read directly and its signature through keytool. Reads the file only.

Annotations: read-only, idempotent, closed world.

| Argument | Type | Required | Default | Details |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `path` | string | yes |  | non-empty; Absolute path of an .apk or .aab file |

```sh
tomaccoctl call android.package_inspect '{"path":"<path>"}'
```
